stories.title: How legal expertise is built into CoCounsel Legal
stories.ltme_summary: Thomson Reuters says CoCounsel Legal is built on attorney-editors from Practical Law and Westlaw, more than 1,300 of whom shape its content, reasoning and benchmarks. The article presents this as its Fiduciary-Grade AI approach.
